answer: One workable design: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because walnut only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. Concretely, wander is enforced in the ledger: Withdrawal limits start near zero and open only against a measured history of accepted answers. Any ledge approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
